description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various types of input stimulus material provided by journalists to LLMs during the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from two identified news agencies. The chart is divided into eight segments, each representing a different type of stimulus material. The largest segment, accounting for 26.4%, is 'Draft/Other', followed by 'Press Release' and 'External News Article', each constituting 18.7% and 18.1% respectively. 'Interview' and 'Event Posting' make up 8.8% and 6.6% of the chart. 'Organizational Report' and 'Organizational Website' are represented by 7.7% and 4.9%. 'Intra-agency news article' and 'Email' are the smallest segments, with 4.9% and 2.7% respectively.
